text:
tara: quick brainstorm: propose a "soft_affinity_token" field in rollout metadata. goal: give clients a stable, low-cost hint for affinity (warm KV/cache/local model warmers) without introducing hard pins.

mihir: curious tradeoffs. how is this different from cohort hints or lease_group?

tara: soft_affinity_token is scoped to a single rollout and encodes both token id and an affinity_window (ms). key is it carries a "prefer_cache" boolean and a routing_hint_priority (int) so resolvers can break ties deterministically.

lucy: resolver complexity concern. need explicit precedence rules vs explicit variant, sticky refs, and cohort hints if both exist.

ben: suggestion: precedence order = explicit-variant -> sticky/canary header -> explicit_sticky_ref -> soft_affinity_token -> cohort_hint -> weighted fallback. make token advisory only.

mihir: telemetry hooks are essential. emit fields: resolver_path enum, affinity_token_applied bool, token_id (if applied), token_staleness_ms, fallback_reason. also count token collisions per-shard.

tara: example metadata patch:
```json
{
  "variants": ["base","quant-8bit","canary-2"],
  "soft_affinity_token": "sft-az-093",
  "affinity_window_ms": 120000,
  "prefer_cache": true,
  "routing_hint_priority": 10
}
```

lucy: ops note: tokens could create hot spots if used naively. recommend default routing_hint_priority low (5) and affinity_window conservative. introduce generator that pseudo-randomly namespaces tokens per-shard.

ben: tenant controls? private/dedicated customers may want opt-out or stricter caps. default: hosted enabled, dedicated/private disabled unless tenant flag true. document this in rollout contract and console toggles.

mihir: add resolver pseudocode in RFC addendum, e.g.:
```
if request.explicit_variant: return explicit
if request.has_sticky_header: return sticky
if manifest.soft_affinity_token and tenant.allows_soft_affinity:
  if now - token_issued_at < affinity_window_ms and random() < policy_prob(routing_hint_priority):
    return pick_affine_variant(manifest)
return weighted_fallback()
```

tara: also propose server-side guardrail: servers should not assign the same soft_affinity_token to more than N active rollouts per-shard to avoid hotspots. include metrics to detect token concentration.

infra-bot: note created: soft_affinity_token schema + resolver pseudocode + telemetry + generator guardrails. assigned: @tara, @mihir. :gear:

ben: test plan: small-scale canary, measure cold-start latency and token concentration. load-tests across shards and tenants.
lucy: please include data retention for token telemetry (short window) and tooling to list tokens per-shard.
tara: will draft RFC addendum covering schema diff, resolver pseudocode, telemetry events, generator changes, and load-test plan. aiming for review in 7 days. :thumbsup:
